answer_1.quote: HSCR achieves performance improvements across a wide range of Med-VQA, captioning, and instruction-following tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language responses for visual question answering, image captioning, and instruction following.

answer_2.quote: For Med-VQA tasks, we follow prior work, using accuracy for closed-set (yes/no) questions and recall for open-set (free-form) questions. For captioning and instruction-following tasks, we employ GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) as an automated evaluator.

answer_3.quote: For captioning and instruction-following tasks, we employ GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) as an automated evaluator. GPT-4 generates a reference answer based on the image and caption, against which the candidate model's response is scored. Each response receives an overall score on a 10-point scale, normalized for comparability, along with a detailed explanation justifying the rating.
methods: Automated scoring with reference answer generation
